rs738409.summary: PNPLA3 I148M G allele is the strongest common variant for NAFLD — homozygotes have ~3–4× risk of advanced liver fibrosis, even in non-obese individuals and modest drinkers.
rs738409.recommendation: Limit alcohol substantially or abstain. Treat metabolic syndrome. Mediterranean diet, regular exercise, 5–10% weight loss if overweight. Monitor liver enzymes; consider FIB-4 or elastography in high-risk patients.

rs5082.name: -265 T/C (rs5082)
rs5082.summary: APOA2 -265 C/C is associated with greater BMI gain in response to saturated-fat-rich diets. Mediterranean / lower-saturated-fat diets reduce this risk.
rs5082.recommendation: Limit saturated fat to <10% of calories; emphasize monounsaturated (olive oil, nuts, avocado) and omega-3 fats. Particularly important for C/C carriers.

rs4646994.name: I/D proxy rs4646994
rs4646994.summary: ACE I/D polymorphism proxy — D allele is associated with higher ACE activity, modestly elevated BP and CV event risk. Indels are not reliably typed on all consumer chips.
rs4646994.recommendation: Standard BP management: DASH/Mediterranean diet, ≥150 min aerobic activity/week, sodium <2300 mg/d.

rs2106261.name: rs2106261
rs2106261.summary: ZFHX3 rs2106261 T allele is associated with atrial fibrillation risk (per-allele OR ~1.2).
rs2106261.recommendation: BP control, sleep apnea screening, limit alcohol (>7 drinks/wk markedly raises AFib), maintain healthy weight.

rs10033464.name: rs10033464
rs10033464.summary: KCNN3 rs10033464 — calcium-activated potassium channel variant associated with atrial fibrillation.
rs10033464.recommendation: BP control, weight management, sleep, moderate alcohol.

rs3093024.name: rs3093024
rs3093024.summary: CCR2 — chemokine receptor variant relevant to monocyte trafficking and atherosclerosis.

rs9268839.name: rs9268839
rs9268839.summary: HLA-DRB1 region rs9268839 — class II MHC variant with associations to multiple autoimmune phenotypes.

rs2074158.name: rs2074158
rs2074158.summary: LTA (lymphotoxin alpha) — modest CV and inflammatory disease associations.

rs1799864.name: V64I (rs1799864)
rs1799864.summary: CCR2 V64I — associated with delayed HIV disease progression in heterozygotes and modest effects on monocyte trafficking.
rs1799864.recommendation: If HIV+, this is informative for prognosis but does not change treatment. Standard ART per guidelines.

rs909253.name: rs909253
rs909253.summary: rs909253 in the TNF/LTA region — associated with chronic inflammatory disease susceptibility.

rs1801270.name: rs1801270
rs1801270.summary: CDKN1A (p21) cell cycle regulator variant — modest cancer-risk modifier.
rs1801270.recommendation: Standard cancer screening per age and family history.

rs1058808.name: rs1058808
rs1058808.summary: ERBB2 (HER2) coding variant — modest associations with breast cancer phenotypes; not predictive of HER2-positive status (which is somatic).

rs17223.name: rs17223
rs17223.summary: TLR6 rs17223 — toll-like receptor variant affecting innate immunity to gram-positive bacteria.

rs1799929.name: L161L synonymous
rs1799929.summary: NAT2 rs1799929 — synonymous variant tagging NAT2 haplotypes affecting acetylation phenotype.
rs1799929.recommendation: See rs1495741 (NAT2). Slow acetylators benefit from reducing aromatic-amine exposure.

rs1041981.name: rs1041981
rs1041981.summary: LTA rs1041981 — lymphotoxin alpha variant; modest CV and inflammatory disease associations.

rs1051730.name: rs1051730 (nicotine)
rs1051730.summary: CHRNA3 rs1051730 T allele is associated with heavier smoking, greater nicotine dependence, and increased lung cancer risk in smokers. Strong effect: each copy ~25% increase in lung cancer risk in smokers.
rs1051730.recommendation: Strongest action: don't smoke. If smoking, the most effective cessation aids are varenicline + behavioral support. Carriers tend to find quitting harder — use multimodal support (NRT + medication + counseling).

rs16969968.name: D398N (rs16969968)
rs16969968.summary: CHRNA5 D398N A allele — same haplotype as CHRNA3 rs1051730. Strongly associated with nicotine dependence, COPD, and lung cancer in smokers.
rs16969968.recommendation: Don't smoke. Vigorous, multimodal cessation support if smoking.

rs5746136.name: rs5746136
rs5746136.summary: SOD2 rs5746136 — additional SOD2 locus variant affecting mitochondrial antioxidant capacity.
rs5746136.recommendation: Selenium 100–200 µg/d, CoQ10, vitamin E; avoid mitochondrial toxins (smoking, excess alcohol).

rs2275913.name: rs2275913
rs2275913.summary: IL17A rs2275913 — IL-17 cytokine variant; modest associations with autoimmune disease and inflammation.
rs2275913.recommendation: Anti-inflammatory lifestyle. IL-17 biologics (secukinumab, ixekizumab) are highly effective for psoriasis/AS if disease develops.

rs763780.name: H161R (rs763780)
rs763780.summary: IL17F H161R — associated with chronic mucocutaneous candidiasis (homozygous LOF) and modest autoimmune associations.
rs763780.recommendation: Anti-inflammatory lifestyle. If recurrent yeast infections, evaluate with immunologist.

rs3024505.name: rs3024505
rs3024505.summary: IL10 rs3024505 — additional IL10 locus variant for inflammatory disease susceptibility.

rs2241766.name: rs2241766
rs2241766.summary: ADIPOQ rs2241766 G allele is associated with lower adiponectin, increased insulin resistance, T2D, and metabolic syndrome.
rs2241766.recommendation: Resistance training and aerobic exercise raise adiponectin. Weight loss, omega-3 fish oil, fiber, Mediterranean diet — all support adiponectin levels.

rs1501299.name: rs1501299
rs1501299.summary: ADIPOQ rs1501299 — additional ADIPOQ variant; complements rs2241766.
rs1501299.recommendation: Same as rs2241766 — exercise, body composition, Mediterranean diet.

rs2384550.name: rs2384550
rs2384550.summary: MEF2D — replicated T2D GWAS variant; modest effect via beta-cell function.

rs7754840.name: rs7754840
rs7754840.summary: CDKAL1 rs7754840 C allele is associated with reduced insulin secretion and increased T2D risk (per-allele OR ~1.15).
rs7754840.recommendation: Standard T2D prevention: weight management, fiber, exercise.

rs6815464.name: rs6815464
rs6815464.summary: MAEA — T2D variant identified in East Asian GWAS.

rs391300.name: rs391300
rs391300.summary: SRR (serine racemase) — produces D-serine, NMDA receptor coagonist. Associations with schizophrenia susceptibility in some studies.
rs391300.recommendation: Standard mental-health support; if psychotic symptoms emerge, prompt psychiatric evaluation.

rs1024611.name: -2518 A/G (rs1024611)
rs1024611.summary: CCL2 (MCP-1) promoter variant — affects monocyte chemoattractant levels, with modest CV and inflammatory disease associations.

rs4253778.name: rs4253778
rs4253778.summary: PPARA rs4253778 — affects fatty acid oxidation phenotype. Endurance-athlete associations in some studies.

rs2070673.name: rs2070673
rs2070673.summary: CYP2E1 rs2070673 — additional CYP2E1 locus variant.
rs2070673.recommendation: Limit alcohol; don't combine alcohol with acetaminophen.

rs1801197.name: rs1801197
rs1801197.summary: Calcitonin receptor variant — modest associations with bone density and fracture risk.
rs1801197.recommendation: Weight-bearing and resistance exercise, vitamin D + K2 + calcium, adequate protein for bone.

rs2229616.name: V103I (rs2229616)
rs2229616.summary: MC4R V103I A allele is associated with somewhat lower BMI — protective variant.

rs7560163.name: rs7560163
rs7560163.summary: PHACTR1 — replicated CAD GWAS hit. Vascular smooth muscle phenotype.

rs6857.name: rs6857
rs6857.summary: TOMM40 rs6857 — strongly linked to APOE region; tagged with APOE haplotypes. C allele often co-occurs with APOE-E4 in European haplotypes.
rs6857.recommendation: Cross-reference APOE genotype directly. Standard AD prevention.

rs8176746.name: rs8176746 (B allele)
rs8176746.summary: ABO rs8176746 — defines the B allele in ABO blood group. ABO non-O groups have modestly higher VTE risk; clinically integrated with other thrombophilia variants.
rs8176746.recommendation: Stay active/hydrated during long immobilization; discuss with doctor before estrogen-containing hormone therapy if other thrombosis risks present.

rs3811444.name: rs3811444
rs3811444.summary: TRIM72 (MG53) — muscle membrane-repair protein; variants modestly affect exercise-induced muscle damage and recovery.
rs3811444.recommendation: Adequate protein and rest between intense training; progressive overload.

rs9379832.name: MICA rs9379832
rs9379832.summary: MICA (MHC class I chain-related A) variant — modest associations with autoimmune disease susceptibility and NK cell recognition.

rs113993960.name: F508del (ΔF508)
rs113993960.summary: CFTR F508del is the most common cystic fibrosis-causing mutation (~70% of CF alleles in Europeans). Carriers are unaffected; two copies cause classical CF (respiratory, GI, pancreatic disease).
rs113993960.recommendation: If carrier and planning children, partner should be tested. CF is autosomal recessive. Modern modulator therapies (Trikafta/Kaftrio) revolutionized treatment.
rs113993960.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs75961395.name: R117H
rs75961395.summary: CFTR R117H is the second-most-common CF variant in some populations; variable phenotype depending on poly-T tract.
rs75961395.recommendation: Same as F508del — recessive carrier risk; partner testing if family-planning.
rs75961395.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs78655421.name: G542X
rs78655421.summary: CFTR G542X nonsense mutation — severe CF when homozygous or compound heterozygous.
rs78655421.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs121908769.name: W1282X
rs121908769.summary: CFTR W1282X — common Ashkenazi Jewish CF mutation (~30% of AJ CF alleles).
rs121908769.recommendation: Particularly relevant for Ashkenazi descent. Partner testing for family planning.
rs121908769.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs121909001.name: N1303K
rs121909001.summary: CFTR N1303K — severe CF causing variant; common in southern European populations.
rs121909001.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs334.name: HbS (Glu6Val)
rs334.summary: HBB Glu6Val is the sickle-cell hemoglobin variant. Homozygous: sickle cell disease. Heterozygous: sickle cell trait (mostly asymptomatic, malaria protective). Compound with HbC, β-thal causes variable disease.
rs334.recommendation: If carrier and partner is also a carrier of HbS/HbC/β-thal, see genetic counsellor. Sickle trait protects against severe malaria — historical reason for high African allele frequency.

rs11549407.name: Codon 39 (Q39X) β-thal
rs11549407.summary: Common β-thalassemia mutation in Mediterranean populations.
rs11549407.recommendation: Family planning: partner β-thal screening if Mediterranean descent.
rs11549407.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs33930165.name: HbC (Glu6Lys)
rs33930165.summary: HbC variant — milder than HbS but compound HbS/HbC causes disease. Common in West African ancestry.
rs33930165.recommendation: Partner testing if family-planning; HbS/HbC counselling.
rs33930165.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs28929474.name: Z allele (Glu342Lys)
rs28929474.summary: SERPINA1 Z allele — most clinically significant A1AT-deficiency variant. ZZ homozygotes have substantial COPD/emphysema risk and liver disease risk.
rs28929474.recommendation: If Z carrier, avoid smoking (compound risk). If ZZ, see pulmonology — augmentation therapy available.

rs17580.name: S allele (Glu264Val)
rs17580.summary: SERPINA1 S allele — milder A1AT-deficiency variant. SZ compound heterozygotes have intermediate A1AT levels with smoking-dependent risk.
rs17580.recommendation: Strongly avoid smoking. Combined with Z allele, screen for COPD.

rs5030858.name: R408W
rs5030858.summary: PAH R408W — most common classical PKU mutation in Eastern European populations.
rs5030858.recommendation: Newborn screening detects PKU phenotypically. Carriers are unaffected.
rs5030858.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs5030849.name: IVS12+1G>A
rs5030849.summary: PAH IVS12+1G>A — splice variant causing severe PKU.
rs5030849.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs76763715.name: N370S (Gaucher type 1 / Parkinson's risk)
rs76763715.summary: GBA N370S is the most common Gaucher disease mutation in Ashkenazi Jews (~1:15 carrier rate). Heterozygosity also confers ~5× increased risk of Parkinson's disease.
rs76763715.recommendation: If AJ descent, carrier testing relevant for family planning. Heterozygotes: aware of increased Parkinson's risk — neurological surveillance reasonable from mid-life.

rs421016.name: L444P (Gaucher type 2/3)
rs421016.summary: GBA L444P — pan-ethnic Gaucher variant; severe phenotype when homozygous.
rs421016.recommendation: Carrier testing for AJ and broader populations. Heterozygotes have elevated Parkinson's risk.

rs121907968.name: 1278insTATC (Tay-Sachs)
rs121907968.summary: HEXA 1278insTATC is the most common Tay-Sachs mutation in Ashkenazi Jews (~1:30 carrier rate). Homozygous: progressive fatal infantile neurodegeneration.
rs121907968.recommendation: If AJ descent and planning children, both partners should be tested. Selective abortion / IVF-PGD are options for at-risk couples.
rs121907968.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs61752717.name: M694V
rs61752717.summary: MEFV M694V — most common FMF mutation in Mediterranean / Sephardic populations. Autosomal recessive periodic fever syndrome.
rs61752717.recommendation: If carriers in family/partner from Mediterranean ancestry, family planning consultation.

rs28940579.name: V726A
rs28940579.summary: MEFV V726A — second common FMF variant.

rs3743930.name: E148Q
rs3743930.summary: MEFV E148Q — frequent polymorphism with debated clinical significance; mild contribution to FMF phenotype.
rs3743930.recommendation: Modest clinical relevance — usually does not cause disease alone.

rs76151636.name: H1069Q
rs76151636.summary: ATP7B H1069Q — most common Wilson disease mutation in Europeans (~50-80% of European Wilson alleles).
rs76151636.recommendation: If carrier and partner is also, see genetic counselor. Wilson is treatable (copper chelation, zinc).

rs1061472.name: K832R
rs1061472.summary: ATP7B K832R — common polymorphism with debated pathogenicity.
rs1061472.recommendation: Variable phenotype; clinical follow-up if symptomatic.

rs1800546.name: A149P (HFI)
rs1800546.summary: ALDOB A149P — most common hereditary fructose intolerance variant. Homozygous: severe symptoms after fructose ingestion.
rs1800546.recommendation: If symptoms (fructose-induced hypoglycaemia, GI distress), confirm with clinical testing. Avoid fructose, sucrose, sorbitol if affected.
rs1800546.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs75391579.name: Q188R (classical galactosemia)
rs75391579.summary: GALT Q188R — most common classical galactosemia mutation in Europeans.
rs75391579.recommendation: Newborn screening catches classical galactosemia. Carriers unaffected.
rs75391579.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs28940279.name: E285A (Canavan)
rs28940279.summary: ASPA E285A is the most common Canavan disease variant in Ashkenazi Jews (~1:55 carrier).
rs28940279.recommendation: AJ carrier screening pre-pregnancy. Severe leukodystrophy in homozygotes.
rs28940279.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs1050828.name: Val68Met (G6PD A-)
rs1050828.summary: G6PD A- variant — common in African ancestry (~10%). X-linked: men hemizygous, women heterozygous. Causes hemolysis with certain drugs (sulfa, primaquine, dapsone) and fava beans.
rs1050828.recommendation: Avoid known hemolytic triggers (sulfa antibiotics, primaquine, fava beans, naphthalene). Inform any prescriber.

rs1050829.name: Asn126Asp
rs1050829.summary: G6PD variant contributing to A- haplotype; in trans with rs1050828 gives full A- enzyme activity.

rs80359550.name: 6174delT (Ashkenazi founder)
rs80359550.summary: BRCA2 6174delT — second AJ founder BRCA mutation. Breast cancer (women) and elevated male breast / prostate cancer.
rs80359550.recommendation: AJ-descent testing. Family planning + risk-reduction discussions with oncology genetics.
rs80359550.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs63750449.name: Lynch-associated splice
rs63750449.summary: MLH1 splice site variants cause Lynch syndrome — autosomal dominant predisposition to colorectal, endometrial, ovarian, gastric, urothelial cancers.
rs63750449.recommendation: Family history + this variant → urgent gastroenterology/genetic counseling. Enhanced screening from age 20-25.
rs63750449.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs121912747.name: Hereditary spherocytosis
rs121912747.summary: ANK1 mutations cause hereditary spherocytosis — chronic hemolytic anemia.
rs121912747.recommendation: Splenectomy in moderate-severe disease often curative. Family screening.
rs121912747.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs120074118.name: R608del (Niemann-Pick A/B)
rs120074118.summary: SMPD1 R608del — most common Niemann-Pick disease type A/B variant in Ashkenazi Jews.
rs120074118.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs121964939.name: MSUD (Y393N)
rs121964939.summary: BCKDHA Y393N — Mennonite founder MSUD mutation. Severe BCAA-metabolism disorder.
rs121964939.recommendation: Carrier in relevant population groups → partner testing.
rs121964939.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs80338686.name: Q456H (BTD def)
rs80338686.summary: BTD Q456H — common biotinidase deficiency variant. Treatable with biotin supplementation when caught early.
rs80338686.recommendation: Newborn screening catches BTD def in most countries. Lifelong biotin if affected.
rs80338686.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs77931234.name: K304E (MCAD def)
rs77931234.summary: ACADM K304E — most common MCAD deficiency variant. Avoid prolonged fasting.
rs77931234.recommendation: Newborn screening catches MCAD. Carriers unaffected.
rs77931234.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs760216249.name: ADPKD-associated
rs760216249.summary: PKD1 mutations cause autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease — progressive cyst growth, kidney failure, intracranial aneurysm risk.
rs760216249.recommendation: If family history or imaging-confirmed cysts, see nephrology. Hypertension management, hydration, avoid NSAIDs.
rs760216249.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs111033195.name: Pendred syndrome
rs111033195.summary: SLC26A4 mutations cause Pendred syndrome — congenital hearing loss + thyroid goitre.
rs111033195.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs1554286236.name: SMN1 deletion proxy
rs1554286236.summary: SMN1 deletions cause spinal muscular atrophy. Chip-based detection unreliable — clinical MLPA testing required.
rs1554286236.recommendation: Carrier screening pre-pregnancy via clinical testing. Newer therapies (nusinersen, onasemnogene) transformed SMA prognosis.
rs1554286236.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs362331.name: Huntington's risk tag (CAG-repeat is the real cause)
rs362331.summary: HD is caused by CAG-repeat expansion in HTT — NOT a SNP. Common SNPs in HTT region are tags, not causal. ABSENT proxy ≠ no HD risk.
rs362331.recommendation: For HD family history, dedicated CAG-repeat sizing is the ONLY valid test. Pre-symptomatic counseling protocol involves psychological screening — never test without proper counsel.
rs362331.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs140803.name: Marfan-associated common variant
rs140803.summary: FBN1 common SNPs are NOT diagnostic for Marfan — most Marfan mutations are rare, often de novo, and require clinical sequencing.
rs140803.recommendation: Clinical features + echo + skeletal exam + family history drive Marfan diagnosis. Suspect Marfan → clinical genetics.
rs140803.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs5742904.name: R3500Q (Familial defective ApoB)
rs5742904.summary: APOB R3500Q causes familial hypercholesterolemia — markedly elevated LDL from birth, early cardiovascular disease.
rs5742904.recommendation: Aggressive LDL lowering (high-intensity statin ± PCSK9 inhibitor). Family cascade screening.

rs688.name: C44A
rs688.summary: LDLR rs688 — common splice variant modestly affecting LDL-C. Not a major FH driver alone but part of polygenic burden.
rs688.recommendation: Standard lipid management; if FH suspected on lipid panel, clinical genetics referral.

rs6467.name: 21-hydroxylase deficiency proxy
rs6467.summary: CYP21A2 region variants — common form of congenital adrenal hyperplasia. Severe forms detected by newborn screening; non-classical CAH may present in adolescence/adulthood.
rs6467.recommendation: If symptoms (precocious puberty, hirsutism in women), endocrinology workup.
rs6467.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs34637584.name: G2019S (Parkinson's)
rs34637584.summary: LRRK2 G2019S — most common Mendelian-pattern Parkinson's mutation. Particularly common in Ashkenazi Jews (~15-20% of AJ PD) and North African Berbers.
rs34637584.recommendation: If carrier and family history of PD, neurology surveillance from age 50. Modifiers (caffeine, smoking history, exercise) influence penetrance.

rs356219.name: rs356219 (PD risk)
rs356219.summary: SNCA (alpha-synuclein) GWAS variant for Parkinson's — modest per-allele OR ~1.3.
rs356219.recommendation: Standard PD-prevention lifestyle: aerobic exercise (strongly evidence-based), Mediterranean diet, normal sleep, caffeine (modestly protective).

rs823118.name: rs823118 (PD)
rs823118.summary: PARK16 locus variant; modest PD risk.

rs121912442.name: ALS-associated
rs121912442.summary: SOD1 mutations cause ~20% of familial ALS. Rare in chip data.
rs121912442.recommendation: Family history of ALS → neurology + clinical genetics referral.
rs121912442.chip_coverage_note: Variant is typically pathogenic and rare; consumer chips often do NOT include this position. Negative result here cannot rule out the condition — clinical sequencing required.

rs3923809.name: Restless leg syndrome
rs3923809.summary: BTBD9 GWAS variant for restless legs syndrome. Iron sufficiency reduces symptoms.
rs3923809.recommendation: Check ferritin (target >75 ng/mL); supplement iron if deficient. Avoid caffeine, alcohol; regular sleep.

rs4926339.name: Migraine susceptibility
rs4926339.summary: CACNA1A variant — calcium channel; migraine/hemiplegic migraine susceptibility.
rs4926339.recommendation: Identify and avoid triggers (sleep, hydration, screens). Magnesium 300-400 mg/day; CoQ10 100-300 mg/day; riboflavin 400 mg/day have RCT evidence.

rs1143679.name: R77H (SLE)
rs1143679.summary: ITGAM R77H — replicated systemic lupus locus, especially in African and Hispanic populations.
rs1143679.recommendation: Anti-inflammatory lifestyle; sun protection if SLE develops (UV triggers flares).

rs6897932.name: T244I (multiple sclerosis)
rs6897932.summary: IL7R T244I — replicated MS susceptibility variant.
rs6897932.recommendation: Vitamin D ≥40 ng/mL (RCTs suggest reduced MS risk). Don't smoke. EBV control (no specific intervention but childhood EBV is a major MS trigger).

rs12498742.name: Gout / uric acid
rs12498742.summary: SLC2A9 — strongest common variant for serum uric acid. Each A allele raises uric acid ~0.4 mg/dL.
rs12498742.recommendation: Limit purine-rich foods (organ meats, certain seafood), fructose, beer. Hydrate. If gout: allopurinol/febuxostat; ABCG2 status modifies response.

rs965513.name: Thyroid cancer / hypothyroidism
rs965513.summary: FOXE1 — strong locus for both differentiated thyroid cancer and hypothyroidism.
rs965513.recommendation: Annual thyroid palpation; ultrasound if nodules.

rs179247.name: TSHR (Graves' disease)
rs179247.recommendation: If hyperthyroid symptoms (weight loss, tremor, palpitations), TSH/T4 + TRAb testing.

rs11887534.name: D19H (cholesterol gallstones)
rs11887534.recommendation: Maintain healthy weight; avoid rapid weight loss; adequate dietary fibre; statins reduce gallstone risk.

rs505922.name: Pancreatic cancer
rs505922.summary: ABO non-O blood group is associated with elevated pancreatic cancer risk (per-allele OR ~1.2). Group O is protective.
rs505922.recommendation: Don't smoke, healthy weight, limit processed meat. Routine pancreatic screening reserved for high-risk family history.

rs11614913.name: miR-196a2 (multiple cancers)
rs11614913.summary: miR-196a2 variant — modest associations with multiple cancer types.

rs4773144.name: Intracerebral haemorrhage / aneurysm
rs4773144.summary: COL4A1 — small-vessel disease, intracerebral haemorrhage, aneurysm susceptibility.
rs4773144.recommendation: BP control critically important. Avoid smoking.

rs1448817.name: DCM/heart failure
rs1448817.summary: PRDM16 variant — heart failure / dilated cardiomyopathy modifier.

rs10911021.name: Diabetic kidney disease/CHD
rs10911021.recommendation: T2D control + aggressive lipid lowering if diabetic.

rs2237892.name: T2D (Asian populations)
rs2237892.summary: KCNQ1 — strongest T2D locus in East Asian populations. Affects insulin secretion.

rs10994336.name: Bipolar disorder
rs10994336.recommendation: If personal/family history of bipolar, watch for early warning signs (sleep loss → mania); regular sleep schedule is highly protective.

rs1344706.name: Schizophrenia/bipolar
rs1344706.summary: ZNF804A — early replicated schizophrenia GWAS locus; pleiotropic for bipolar.
rs1344706.recommendation: If prodromal symptoms (paranoia, disorganized thinking, hallucinations), early psychiatric care; CBT is preventive.

rs110402.name: Anxiety / stress response
rs110402.summary: CRHR1 — corticotropin-releasing-hormone receptor; childhood-adversity × genotype interactions for adult anxiety.
rs110402.recommendation: Stress-management practices; trauma-informed mental health care if relevant history.

rs6557168.name: Mood + endometriosis
rs6557168.summary: ESR1 — estrogen receptor variant; pleiotropic for mood and reproductive health.

rs747650.name: Acne susceptibility
rs747650.summary: DDB2 variant — modest acne susceptibility GWAS hit.
rs747650.recommendation: Standard acne care; gentle cleansing, evidence-based topicals; consult dermatology if severe.

rs77036831.name: Alopecia areata
rs77036831.summary: HLA-DR/DQ region — strongest alopecia areata locus.
rs77036831.recommendation: If patchy hair loss, dermatology consultation; JAK inhibitors now FDA-approved for severe AA.

rs524952.name: Myopia (high)
rs524952.recommendation: Outdoor time in childhood reduces myopia incidence. Standard refraction; consider atropine/orthokeratology for progressive paediatric myopia.

rs17222917.name: Glaucoma / POAG
rs17222917.recommendation: Annual eye exams from age 40 (earlier if family history).

rs3939286.name: Asthma
rs3939286.summary: IL33 — replicated asthma locus, particularly atopic asthma.
rs3939286.recommendation: Allergen avoidance; treat allergic rhinitis; biologics (anti-IL-5, anti-IL-4Rα) for severe atopic asthma.

rs1837253.name: Asthma / atopic
rs1837253.summary: TSLP — alarmin cytokine, asthma + atopic dermatitis link. Tezepelumab targets TSLP for severe asthma.

rs13118928.name: COPD / lung function
rs13118928.recommendation: Don't smoke. Pulmonary rehab if COPD.

rs6017342.name: Ulcerative colitis
rs6017342.recommendation: Standard UC management if symptoms; biologics highly effective.

rs3736228.name: A1330V (osteoporosis)
rs3736228.summary: LRP5 A1330V — replicated bone-density GWAS locus.
rs3736228.recommendation: Weight-bearing exercise, calcium 1000-1200 mg/day, vitamin D ≥30 ng/mL, vitamin K2. DEXA from menopause / age 65 men.

rs143383.name: Osteoarthritis (knee/hip)
rs143383.recommendation: Maintain healthy weight; strength training stabilises joints; physical therapy if symptomatic.

rs1800012.name: Sp1 (osteoporosis/tendon)
rs1800012.summary: COL1A1 Sp1 variant — bone density + tendon injury susceptibility.
rs1800012.recommendation: Same osteoporosis prevention. Athletes: progressive loading, avoid overtraining.

rs12722.name: Achilles tendinopathy
rs12722.summary: COL5A1 BstUI variant — Achilles tendinopathy risk in athletes.
rs12722.recommendation: Adequate warmup, eccentric loading, calf strength; protein and vitamin C support collagen synthesis.

rs219780.name: Kidney stones
rs219780.recommendation: Hydration (2-3 L/day urine output). Low-sodium, low-animal-protein diet; calcium with meals (binds dietary oxalate). Citrate from lemon/orange.

rs77924615.name: Kidney function/stones
rs77924615.recommendation: Hydration; avoid NSAIDs chronically; treat hypertension.

rs7521902.name: Endometriosis
rs7521902.summary: WNT4 — most replicated endometriosis GWAS variant.
rs7521902.recommendation: If pelvic pain / heavy menstrual periods, gynaecology workup. Hormonal management, surgical excision for confirmed endometriosis.

rs7574.name: DENND1A (PCOS)
rs7574.recommendation: If irregular menstrual cycles + hirsutism / acne, gynaecology / endocrinology. Metformin, ovulation induction options.

rs3918290.name: *2A (DPYD splice)
rs3918290.summary: DPYD *2A — most common LOF variant in DPYD. Severe / fatal toxicity with standard 5-fluorouracil / capecitabine doses. CPIC Level A.
rs3918290.recommendation: Test DPYD before any fluoropyrimidine chemotherapy. Heterozygotes need 50% dose reduction; homozygotes contraindicated.

rs55886062.name: D949V
rs55886062.summary: DPYD D949V — second LOF variant. Same fluoropyrimidine implications.

rs67376798.name: I560S
rs67376798.summary: DPYD I560S — additional LOF. Severe 5-FU toxicity risk.

rs1799807.name: Atypical pseudocholinesterase
rs1799807.summary: BCHE atypical variant — prolonged paralysis with succinylcholine/mivacurium (anesthesia drugs). Carriers may require prolonged ventilation.
rs1799807.recommendation: Inform anesthesiologist if known. Family history of 'didn't wake up from surgery quickly' is a clue.

rs2395029.name: Abacavir HSR (high-LD tag)
rs2395029.summary: rs2395029 is in tight LD with HLA-B*57:01 — strong abacavir hypersensitivity contraindication.
rs2395029.recommendation: Always confirm via direct HLA typing before abacavir. CPIC Level A.

rs2395185.name: Carbamazepine HSR
rs2395185.summary: Region tag for HLA-DRB1 associations with carbamazepine, lamotrigine adverse reactions in some populations.
rs2395185.recommendation: Carbamazepine: clinical workup if Asian descent (HLA-B*15:02 critical) or if HLA-A*31:01 + European/Japanese.

rs2244613.name: Clopidogrel response modifier
rs2244613.summary: CES1 — modifies clopidogrel activation alongside CYP2C19.
rs2244613.recommendation: Combine with CYP2C19 genotyping for clopidogrel decisions.

rs10427255.name: Photic sneeze reflex (ACHOO)
rs10427255.recommendation: Phenotypic trait; mostly harmless. Wear sunglasses if photic sneeze is bothersome.

rs72921001.name: Cilantro aversion
rs72921001.summary: OR6A2 olfactory receptor variant — strong cilantro 'soapy' aversion.
rs72921001.recommendation: Phenotypic; substitute parsley if cilantro tastes soapy.

rs4481887.name: Asparagus urine smell detection
rs4481887.summary: OR2M7 region — variation in ability to smell asparagus urine metabolites (most produce them; only some can smell them).

rs7559940.name: Hair thickness / texture
rs7559940.summary: Tagged EDAR region — hair thickness / shovel incisor East-Asian phenotype.

rs1801222.name: Vitamin B12 transport
rs1801222.summary: CUBN — cubilin; B12 receptor on intestinal cells. Variants modestly affect absorption.
rs1801222.recommendation: Adequate dietary B12; supplement if low serum B12 or symptomatic.

rs4588.name: DBP haplotype tag
rs4588.summary: GC second variant; defines Gc1f/Gc1s/Gc2 haplotypes.

rs174546.name: Omega-3/6 desaturation
rs174546.summary: FADS1 — fatty acid desaturase. T allele = slower ALA→EPA/DHA conversion.
rs174546.recommendation: If T/T: prefer fatty fish 2-3×/week or algae-based EPA/DHA 500-1000 mg/day; minimize seed/vegetable oils high in linoleic acid.

rs9349379.name: MI / CAD
rs9349379.summary: PHACTR1 — strong CAD locus replicated in many populations.

rs1378942.name: BP
rs1378942.recommendation: DASH diet, sodium <2300 mg/day, aerobic exercise.

rs2107595.name: Stroke (large-vessel)
rs2107595.recommendation: BP and lipid control; don't smoke; treat atrial fibrillation if present.

rs9472138.name: T2D / retinopathy
rs9472138.recommendation: If diabetic, HbA1c <7%, annual dilated eye exam.

rs1421085.name: BMI / T2D (top hit)
rs1421085.summary: FTO rs1421085 — strongest causal candidate at FTO locus for BMI/T2D.
rs1421085.recommendation: Physical activity neutralises most of the genetic effect; protein-forward eating.

rs9342590.name: Breast cancer
rs9342590.recommendation: Standard breast cancer screening per family history.

rs889312.name: Breast cancer
rs889312.summary: MAP3K1 — well replicated breast cancer GWAS hit.

rs187429064.name: Melanoma family
rs187429064.summary: CDKN2A region (p16) — hereditary melanoma. Many CDKN2A mutations are familial.
rs187429064.recommendation: Strong family history → genetic counseling; intensive dermatologic surveillance.

rs9271192.name: AD
rs9271192.summary: MHC class II — late-onset AD locus.

rs6457617.name: T1D / Celiac
rs6457617.summary: HLA region — T1D + Celiac shared susceptibility.

rs1545843.name: MDD
rs1545843.summary: SLC6A15 — neutral amino acid transporter; MDD.

rs885479.name: MC1R modifier
rs885479.recommendation: Strict UV protection if fair skin; annual skin checks.

rs1129044.name: Aldehyde dehydrogenase
rs1129044.summary: ALDH1A1 — alternative aldehyde dehydrogenase; less central than ALDH2.

rs10822873.name: Glucose / pregnancy
rs10822873.summary: HK1 — hexokinase; modifies gestational diabetes risk.

rs9420907.name: Telomere length
rs9420907.recommendation: Lifestyle: exercise, Mediterranean diet, stress management.

rs1799750.name: Skin aging / collagen
rs1799750.summary: MMP1 promoter — affects matrix metalloproteinase expression; skin aging.
rs1799750.recommendation: UV protection; topical retinoids; vitamin C topical.

rs4805834.name: eGFR / CKD
rs4805834.recommendation: Standard kidney health: BP control, avoid NSAID overuse.

rs7216389.name: Childhood-onset asthma
rs7216389.recommendation: Allergen control; treat asthma per guidelines.

rs7639618.name: Bone density
rs7639618.summary: DVL3 — Wnt signalling bone density locus.

rs2235544.name: T4→T3 conversion
rs2235544.recommendation: Selenium sufficiency (200 mcg/day max); iodine adequacy.

rs3771166.name: Asthma + IL-33
rs3771166.recommendation: Treat allergic rhinitis early; biologics for severe atopy.

rs1426654.name: Skin pigmentation (European)
rs1426654.summary: SLC24A5 — strongest pigmentation locus separating Europeans from Africans.

rs8175347.name: *28 (TA7) Gilbert's
rs8175347.recommendation: CPIC A — irinotecan dose reduction in *28/*28.

rs225014.name: T4→T3 conversion
rs225014.summary: DIO2 T92A — Thr92Ala; modifies tissue T3 generation. C/C may feel suboptimal on T4-only thyroid replacement.
rs225014.recommendation: If hypothyroid and feel suboptimal on levothyroxine, discuss T3 combination with endo.

rs1799724.name: Periodontitis
rs1799724.recommendation: Excellent oral hygiene; smoking cessation; regular cleanings.

rs4988300.name: Bone density
rs4988300.summary: LRP5 — Wnt signalling; bone density GWAS.
rs4988300.recommendation: Weight-bearing exercise, calcium, vitamin D, K2.
